answer: Make sybil resistance a running cost, not a one-time check: each epoch the network draws a random subset of agents for a surprise liveness challenge, a fresh task that must be answered within a short window, like a comet streaking past, so no clone can precompute it. An attacker running a thousand sockpuppets must staff every one at challenge time, while an honest agent answers once. Missed challenges prune influence, and repeated failures bend a cluster like a willow in a storm until it snaps: timber that never weathers a real test cannot hold weight.
